_comment: Run-scoped blessings from the Ashen Court. `mods` keys use the StatBlock grammar (core/stat_block.gd) and are scaled by the offer's rarity. Boons own the `more` buckets; gear owns flat and increased. Each elemental god has ONE ungated entry boon that grants its tag and seeds a little of its damage type — everything else in that god's tree is `more.<type>` gated behind the tag, so it is worthless until you have committed. Odrin is the ungated generalist whose multipliers are global. Groups are per-god so gods stack rather than compete for one slot. | Masteries follow Diablo II's asymmetry deliberately: Fire and Lightning Mastery multiply your damage, Cold Mastery subtracts the target's resistance. Those are different shapes of upgrade — a multiplier against a 75% resistant target keeps a quarter of its face value forever, while penetration attacks the denominator and can carry a target past zero resistance into taking extra. See core/damage.gd for the clamp ordering that makes it work.

boons.name: Weight of the Chain
boons.description: Your strikes land heavier. All of them.

boons.name: Hungering Edge
boons.description: Wounds you open do not close.

boons.name: Iron Vigil
boons.description: Stand, and it will break on you.

boons.name: Butcher's Rhythm
boons.description: Brutality begets brutality.

boons.name: Ember in the Lung
boons.description: A small fire, carried. It is not much yet.

boons.name: Feed the Pyre
boons.description: It grows if you let it.

boons.name: Scalding Ward
boons.description: Heat answers heat.

boons.name: Conflagration
boons.description: Everything you touch is already burning.

boons.name: Rime on the Teeth
boons.description: Cold enough to slow a thing down. Barely.

boons.name: Shatterpoint
boons.description: Frozen things break cleanly.

boons.name: The Long Stillness
boons.description: Nothing hurries here.

boons.name: Hollow Winter
boons.description: The cold stops being weather and becomes a place.

boons.name: Arcing Fury
boons.description: It looks for the next one. Give it something to find.

boons.name: Stormtouched
boons.description: The air will not settle around you.

boons.name: Gale Step
boons.description: Be elsewhere.

boons.name: Unspent Thunder
boons.description: Held too long, released badly.

boons.name: Patient Rot
boons.description: It has time. You may not.

boons.name: Seeping Wound
boons.description: The cut keeps working after you have gone.

boons.name: Thickened Blood
boons.description: Harder to spoil.

boons.name: Late Bloom
boons.description: What you planted several floors ago comes due.

boons.name: Cruel Momentum
boons.description: Two gods agree, for once.

boons.name: The Toll
boons.description: Everything given is also taken.

boons.name: Thin the Veil
boons.description: You see a little more of what is coming.

boons.name: The Long Ledger
boons.description: Debts recorded, slowly repaid.

boons.name: Cold Mastery
boons.description: Their resistance to cold is a suggestion.

boons.name: Fire Mastery
boons.description: Everything you burn, burns harder.

boons.name: Lightning Mastery
boons.description: The arc finds more of them, and finds them harder.

boons.name: The Long Winter
boons.description: Cold enough that what it touches forgets how to hurry.

boons.name: Warmth
boons.description: The fire feeds you back.

boons.name: Wild Arc
boons.description: Lightning was never fair. Lean into it.
